description: Offres de stationnement sur voierie is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Localisation de l'ensemble des offres de stationnement existantes (voitures particulières, PMR, vélo, deux-roues motorisés, autopartage, électromobilité...) sur la voirie, à l'échelle du segment de voie. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are stationnement. The portal shows 28,961 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
